Proposition
[Existence of Smooth Bump Functions]

1. ch2:2.25For every closed $A$ in a smooth manifold $M$ and every open $U\supseteq A$, there is a smooth bump function for $A$ supported in $U$.

Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 2 to $\{ U,M\setminus A\} $, obtaining $\psi _0,\psi _1$. Since $\psi _1$ vanishes on $A$, $\psi _0=1$ on $A$ and has support in $U$.

□
